rv.q: This beautifully acted and thoughtfully staged “Measure for Measure” proves there is plenty worth measuring here.
The show has many laugh beats and is a good time.
So yes, it’s a strange and dark play, but it’s deftly handled and an interesting watch.
It's still a well-paced and entertaining evening, and with its dangling final 'will she or won't she' moment, it makes for good conversation on the drive home.
Dancing between death and comedy, still there’s no better place to revel in Shakespeare than the Old Globe.

cn.t: Critics praise the Old Globe's clear-eyed production of Shakespeare's "problem play," with strong performances and clever design that lean into rather than smooth over the work's moral contradictions and tonal shifts.
